summary: Verified both requested UI changes on TaskMint web preview (frontend-only; app uses Firestore directly). (a) PASS: Home tab > Offerwall segment (home-segmented-offerwall) lists 2 real Firestore tasks; tapping a task card (task-card-*) opens task-detail-modal which contains ONLY the 'Start task' button (testID 'task-start-button' present, visible). No element with testID 'task-open-link' exists and no 'Open task link' text renders anywhere in the modal. Confirmed both at runtime (DOM queries) and by code inspection of TaskDetailModal.tsx (only 'task-start-button'/'task-submit-button'/'task-proof-input' remain). (b) PASS: Profile tab long-press (~900ms, threshold 600ms) on version text (testID 'profile-version', 'TaskMint v1.0.0') opens popup titled 'How are you doing?' (testID 'admin-key-modal'). Typed 'HelloVisible123' into admin-key-input: rendered input has NO type='password' attribute (secureTextEntry removed) and screenshot confirms characters visible as plain text, not dots. Wrong-key Send correctly shows greet-modal, so popup logic intact. Regression: onboarding (login-continue-button -> details name/mobile -> submit) works, welcome popup claims 1,000 pts, Home/Wallet/Profile tabs all navigate cleanly (home-points, wallet-balance, profile-version all render). Zero unexpected console errors (only expected web warnings: expo-notifications web limitation, shadow* deprecation). No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) present; SafeAreaView from react-native used correctly via safe-area-context insets.

issues: Minor: version Pressable (profile-version) touch target is ~35px tall (fontSize 13 + paddingVertical 8) - slightly below the 44px guideline. Acceptable for a hidden affordance; only note if main agent wants stricter a11y.

action_items: None - both requested changes verified working in the live web preview. No fixes required.
critical_code_review_comments: TaskDetailModal.tsx:86-95 - 'Start task' Button (task-start-button) is the only CTA for un-submitted, submission-enabled tasks; no 'Open task link' block remains. Start-task already calls Linking.openURL(task.taskUrl) internally, so removing the separate open-link button loses no functionality.

profile.tsx:116-124 - admin-key-input TextInput has no secureTextEntry prop; typed text is visible as required. autoCapitalize='none' retained - note the admin key 'TaskMint000' is case-sensitive, so users must type the capital T/M on mobile keyboards with autocaps off (pre-existing behavior, not part of this change).
Hardcoded ADMIN_KEY ('TaskMint000') in profile.tsx:15 is a client-side check - trivially readable from the bundle. Pre-existing design from user's repo; flag as informational only.
